'''Oti Trinta''' was a member of the [[Naboo Diplomatic Corps]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], when the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] invaded Naboo, Trinta quickly became one of the leaders of the [[Naboo Resistance]]. Trinta was in charge of general operations for a particular cell of the Resistance. Trinta attended a meeting with [[Mett Habble/Legends|Mett Habble]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Nathaniel Camaran|Camaran]] to convince several capable passengers from the [[Crescent (freighter)|Crescent]] to join the Resistance.
